title: Database Function Mapping Complete

layers.db5_api: ~50 db_* C wrappers (0x5AAxxxx). Pattern: db_*(args){dispatcher(CMD,args);return err==0;}
layers.db5_dispatchers: 6 dispatch wrappers (0x5ACxxxx-0x5ADxxxx). Handle logging, error tracing, command history.
layers.db4_element_record: 4 core implementation functions (0x5AExxxx-0x5AFxxxx). Element navigation, header access, DB open.
layers.db2_page_io: 2 page I/O functions with retry/mode-switch. Error string: '2RP:Name=%.256s,Pageno=%d,Token=%d,Flayer error=%.64s'
layers.db1_fortran: 21 FH* Fortran functions. FHDBRN(page read), FHDBWN(page write), FHSPLT(B+tree split), FHFIND(index find), etc.
layers.db1_cpp_bridge: sub_5B9B400: IToken→DirectAccessToken via RTDynamicCast, vtable[4] for actual I/O
layers.db0_file_layer: 6 FL* functions. FLOPEN, FLCLOS, FLPAGE, FLDELE, FLFINI.

call_chain_traced: db_read_page → dispatcher → sub_5AFB660 (page cache) → sub_5AF0640 (retry/mode-switch) → FHDBRN (Fortran) → sub_5B9B400 (C++ bridge) → DirectAccessToken::vtable[4] (disk I/O)
evidence: decompile of 8 key functions + callees analysis of 6 dispatchers + func_query for FH*/FL*/SY*/DB* families
